mechanism_description: 1715 약세 상태(bad_state_t)에서만 기대수익/방어력이 올라가는 complement sleeve를 학습. p_bad_1715(t+1) classifier가 다음 sig_date의 bad state 확률을 forecast → a_t = clip(a_max · p_bad, 0, a_max)로 conditional injection rate 결정. w_final(t) = (1-a_t)·w_1715(t) + a_t·w_comp(t)로 blend. 1715 alpha core 100% retain (replacement X), complement는 small overlay (a_max 5-20%). 4-stage incremental admission (Linear PPP → Elastic Net → LightGBM → DPL-RC Neural), 각 stage incremental gain 입증 시에만 다음 stage 진행. Ferson-Schadt 1996 conditional alpha + Brandt 2009 PPP + AFP 2014 BAB crisis hedge + AC-M 2023 ML conditional + Wood 2026 DeePM 정합. 80 features (v2 inherit defensive 55%) → bad-state context 자연 fit. 7-axis admission (overall SR ≥ 1.97 + MDD ≥ -24.81% + good_drag ≤ 0.05 + bad_improve ≥ +0.30 + TO ≤ 6 + |cor| ≤ 0.3 + p_bad AUC ≥ 0.55).

FF3: blend return vs MKT + SMB + HML (KR 동등 인용)
